name: Algebraic Span Obfuscation
description: Replaces the geometric concept of a "contiguous 1D streak" with pure integer sets, enforcing contiguity by requiring the size of the union to equal M - m + 1 (where m and M are the global minimum and maximum of the sets). This prevents models from pattern-matching "contiguous pixels" to the additive inequality p1+p2 > T, forcing them to derive the inequality algebraically from the bounds.
